about: Request a Good Standing Certificate or a licence details verification as a current or past DHA professional.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: You must have no unpaid fines
Anyone who was suspended or revoked, or under investigation in the past two years, gets a Certificate of Current Status instead
Licence verification needs a past DHA licence
documents: For the certificate, none unless your passport copy is out of date
For licence verification, the verification form, a valid passport copy and a copy of your last DHA licence
